theme_overview: A weekly population of 240 genetic-programming trading rules is scored with noise and the top one is seated when it clears an absolute bar, with no incumbent and no concurrent control. The maximum of noisy scores is biased upward (winner's curse). Looking for implementations that shrink the selected estimate and that design the re-evaluation after seating.
goal: implementation anchors for post-selection shrinkage of the top-ranked backtest and probation rules
why_problem: the best of 240 noisy scores overstates its true value and nothing discounts it
assumptions: scores are noisy and candidates are closely related
there is no incumbent to compare against
